profiles.name: drum-machine
profiles.text:
# name: drum machine
# publish: yes
# ANALOG 2 for bass, SAMPLE, GRAIN, SLICE; the X0X 909 and 808 kits beside the drum synth and the sampled kits; USB audio +
# MIDI; the help line. Off: DIGITAL, PHASE, LOFI, VOICE, TRIO, WHEEL, FM6; every sample set (each can still be uploaded to
# a USR slot); the web editor.
# 2026-10-19: the user's refit (config/my-profiles/drum machine.config) after SLOOP's UI went (the profile had it: +30 KB)
# firmware builder configuration (tools/builder/registry.py keys; others take their defaults)
# Synth engines
ENG_DIGITAL=0
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_LOFI=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_FM6=0
ENG_SLICE=1
# Drums
DRUM_X0X909=1
X909_CYM=0
DRUM_X0X808=1
# 2026-10-21: out to fit, the scene backports' biggest: the PLAITS kit (DS_PLAITS, ~5 KB; the KAWA kit and the rest stay in)
DS_PLAITS=0
# Sample sets
SET_PIANO=0
SET_BASS=0
SET_VIBES=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_SCRCH=0
# FX: any number (each track its own)
FX_DJF=0
FX_DUST=0
INS_FUZZ=1
# FX: limited instances (once, or a set count)
DLY_LEN=32768
REV_ROOM=0
REV_FDN8=1
PUNCH_N=16384
# Sequencer
PATTERNS=1
# MIDI & USB
USB_CONSOLE=0
USB_AUDIO=1
MIDI_EXPR=0
MIDI_NOTEOUT=0
# UI
PARAM_HELP=1
BRIGHT=0
# System
EDITOR=0
BACKUP=0
LIBRARIAN=0
ED_LIVE=0
ED_MIX=0
ED_SEQ=0
ED_SCREENS=0
SL24_SAFE=0
SL24_IMPORT=0
# COND (step conditions) brings the automation store, so the drum ACCENT lane (2026-10-20)
COND=1
MASTER_COMP=0
BT_AUDIO=1
UART=1

profiles.name: everything-that-fits
profiles.text:
# name: everything fits
# publish: yes
# Every engine (CZ too; not TRIO), FM6 option, kit, FX and feature; the CDC console; the help line; the reverb's lines in
# the pool. Out to fit: VIBES, HORNS, STRINGS, FLUTE and SCRATCH (each can still be uploaded to a USR slot), the SLICER,
# the PUNCH ring at 0.37 s, the ducker, the LCD's changed-rectangle strips, the web editor's live editing (its backup and
# librarian stay).
# 2026-10-19: the user's refit (config/my-profiles/everything fits.config) after SLOOP's UI went (the profile had it: +33 KB)
# firmware builder configuration (tools/builder/registry.py keys; others take their defaults)
# Synth engines
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_CZ=1
# Sample sets
SET_VIBES=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_SCRCH=0
# FX: any number (each track its own)
FX_SLICER=0
SL_LEN=2048
# FX: limited instances (once, or a set count)
DLY_LEN=32768
REV_POOL=1
PUNCH_N=16384
FX_DUCK=0
# MIDI & USB
USB_CONSOLE=0
USB_AUDIO=1
# UI
PARAM_HELP=1
LCD_DIRTY=0
# System
ED_LIVE=0
# COND (step conditions) brings the automation store, so the drum ACCENT lane (2026-10-20)
COND=1
SET_PIANO=0
BT_AUDIO=1
UART=1
# 2026-10-21: the scene backports out to fit (184 B were free): FILT RESO (TFLT_RESO), PHASE FOLD (PHASE_FOLD), the KAWA and PLAITS kits (DS_KAWA, DS_PLAITS); TUNE on the noise sounds and the own-voice reuse are in
TFLT_RESO=0
PHASE_FOLD=0
DS_KAWA=0
DS_PLAITS=0

profiles.name: fm-va-studio
profiles.text:
# name: FM + VA studio
# publish: yes
# ANALOG 2, FM6 (every option), DIGITAL, SAMPLE, TRIO; every kit; the PIANO, BASS and STRINGS sets (the others can
# still be uploaded to a USR slot); every FX but PUNCH (off 2026-10-20: room for COND and the ACCENT lane); the CDC console.
# Off: GRAIN, VOICE, LOFI, PHASE, WHEEL (and the experiments).
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_LOFI=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_GRAIN=0
USB_CONSOLE=0
USB_AUDIO=1
SET_SCRCH=0
PATTERNS=1
# 2026-10-18: out to fit again (the firmware grew): FLUTE and HORNS (each can still be uploaded to a USR slot), the PUNCH ring at 0.37 s (pool)
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_HORNS=0
FX_PUNCH=0
# 2026-10-19: out to fit since SLOOP's UI went (the profile had it: +21 KB): VIBES (the user's choice)
SET_VIBES=0
# 2026-10-21: the web editor's mixer and screen pages out to fit (the SONG tables grew the firmware by ~3 KB): ED_MIX, ED_SCREENS (the editor still edits sounds, patterns, the song)
ED_MIX=0
ED_SCREENS=0
# COND (step conditions) brings the automation store, so the drum ACCENT lane (2026-10-20)
COND=0
# 2026-10-21: out to fit (the SONG tables, the lists and the wipe grew the firmware): the DJ filter effect (FX_DJF, 1.8 KB; a FILTER insert is TRK_FILT's)
FX_DJF=0
SET_PIANO=0
BT_AUDIO=1
UART=1
# 2026-10-21: out to fit, the scene backports' biggest: the PLAITS kit (DS_PLAITS, ~5 KB; the KAWA kit and the rest stay in)
DS_PLAITS=0
